name: cura-Sovol-SV02 (Legacy)
start_gcode:
G21 ;metric values
G28 ;home all
G90 ;absolute positioning
M107 ;start with the fan off
G1 F2400 Z15.0 ;raise the nozzle 15mm
M109 S195 ;Set Extruder Temperature and Wait
M190 S60; Wait for bed temperature to reach target temp
T0 ;Switch to Extruder 1
G1 F3000 X5 Y10 Z0.2 ;move to prime start position
G92 E0 ;reset extrusion distance
G1 F600 X160 E5 ;prime nozzle in a line
G1 F5000 X180 ;quick wipe
G92 E0 ;reset extrusion distance
end_gcode:
M104 S0  ;hotend off
M140 S0  ;bed off
G92 E0
G1 F2000 E-100  ;retract filament 100mm
G92 E0
G1 F3000 X0 Y240  ;move bed for easy part removal
M84  ;disable steppers
